title: Sirocco's Lamp Bazaar
infoTitle: SIROCCO'S LAMP BAZAAR · HOW IT PLAYS

tiers.name: GENIE'S BLESSING
tiers.tag: Sirocco bows to no one. Tonight he bows to you.

tiers.name: LAMP ABLAZE
tiers.tag: The whole bazaar turns to look.

tiers.name: GOLDEN HOUR
tiers.tag: The sun lingers on your stall.

buys.name: Free Wishes
buys.text: Three or more FS suns blaze at once and Sirocco grants 10 free wishes. The chain multiplier never resets and climbs with every winning link.
buys.confirmText: FREE WISHES: 3 or more FS land, then 10+ free spins where the chain multiplier never resets (up to x12).

buys.name: Astrolabe of Wishes
buys.text: Three or more Astrolabes land. Three rings turn and stop one by one: cash, a multiplier, and maybe a WISH jackpot up to GRAND.
buys.confirmText: ASTROLABE OF WISHES: 3 or more Astrolabes land, then 4 to 8 spins of three rings: cash x multiplier, plus a jackpot wish if the core lights.

buys.name: Three Wishes
buys.text: Four or five FS land: the SUPER round. The chain multiplier starts at x3, climbs to x15, and never resets.
buys.confirmText: THREE WISHES (SUPER): 4 or 5 FS land, then 12 or 15 free spins with the multiplier starting at x3 and capped at x15.

intro.quote: "Rub the lamp once. The sun does the rest."
intro.tap: TAP ANYWHERE TO MAKE A WISH
chips: EVERY WINNING LINK RAISES IT BY ONE

outro.label: YOUR WINNINGS
outro.quote: "The lamp is warm. Come back at sunset."

fever.name: Djinn's Favour
fever.text: Pay 2x per spin: bonuses trigger about three times as often and Wish Gems sometimes arrive for free. Stays on until you switch it off.
fever.onMsg: DJINN'S FAVOUR ON. TOTAL BET x2
